# CodeMirror 5.65.21

Unmodified upstream files from https://www.npmjs.com/package/codemirror/v/5.65.21
(downloaded via https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/codemirror@5.65.21/):

- `lib/codemirror.js` → `codemirror.js`
- `lib/codemirror.css` → `codemirror.css`
- `mode/python/python.js` → `python.js`
- `LICENSE` (MIT)

Served locally through Django static files. No runtime editor CDN or build step.
Update these files together and rerun Lab tests when upgrading. Custom styling
and configuration belong in `lab.css` and `lab.js`, not these vendor files.
